transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Your Name]. What brings you in today?
I guess... I just hardly eat right anymore. Some days it's just coffee, maybe a piece of bread. My pants are hanging loose on me now. That's... that's why I'm here, I guess.
Have you lost your appetite or found yourself not interested in eating?
Yeah... like I just said. I just don't really care about food right now. I'm not hungry.
Have you noticed any significant weight loss recently, or has your lack of interest in eating affected your daily life in other ways?

Yeah... like I said, my clothes don't fit. And... I guess it affects other stuff. I just don't do much. My family has been... they have to help me out a lot lately. With money... giving me rides. I can't really handle my errands anymore. They even have to help me with paperwork and things... I just... I'm not keeping up with anything right now.
Have you been feeling down, depressed, or hopeless most days lately?

Yeah... I guess. Just... most days, I wake up and... there's this heavy feeling. Like an empty spot in my chest, I don't know. It just feels like there ain't nothing good waiting for me out there anyway. So I just... mostly I just want to keep my head down. That's all.
Has this feeling of being down or hopeless been present most of the day, nearly every day?
Yeah... pretty much. Just... all day, really. It don't really go away.
Have you felt more tired or lacking in energy lately, even if you're not doing much physically?

Yeah... I'm just tired. All the time. Even just... taking out the trash or coming here to the clinic... it's just too much. It feels like... I don't know, like my arms and legs are just full of wet sand. Just heavy.
Have you found it hard to focus or think clearly lately?

Yeah... just foggy, I guess. I can't really... keep my mind on things. Like bills or forms. I just... I don't know. Even at the store, I just end up standing there. Getting stuck on little things... like what can of soup to get. Just... hard to think.
Have you had any thoughts about death or dying, or wished you were dead?
No... I don't... not really. Just... just want to sleep, I guess. But... no. I don't think about that.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy, or found that you don't get pleasure from them anymore?

I guess... yeah. I used to go down and walk by the lake. Or... work on my little model kits. But now... they just sit there. I don't know. I just look at them and... it's like they belong to somebody else. I just don't care about them anymore.
How long have you been feeling this way?
I don't know... a while. Maybe... about five months now. It's just... been hanging over me, I guess.
Have you noticed that you're moving slower than usual, or that even small tasks take you much longer to complete?

I guess... yeah. My family, they... they say I move like I'm walking through mud. And... I don't know. Sometimes they ask me something, just a simple question, and... it just takes me a long time to get the words out. It's just... hard.
Have you found yourself feeling worthless or guilty about things lately?

Yeah... I guess so. I just... I think about how I lost that job. And now... my family has to help me out. It just... makes me feel like I'm no good. I just sit there and... go over every mistake I made. Like... like I just ruined everything.
Have you found that nothing gives you pleasure anymore, not even things you used to enjoy?

I don't know... I guess so. I used to... I liked walking by the lake. And I had these little model kits I'd work on. But... I haven't touched them in a long time. They just sit there. I look at them and... it's like they belong to somebody else. I just don't care about them anymore.
Have you found that absolutely nothing gives you pleasure anymore, even things that used to make you happy?
I... I think I just answered that. Like I said, I don't really do the things I used to. It's just... I don't care about them now.
Have you ever felt this way before, with periods of feeling down and losing interest in things, or is this the first time you've experienced something like this?
I don't know... maybe. It's hard to remember. I just... I feel like this now.
